integrity: A complete algebraic proof derives the saturated Jacobian scheme, normality, its Hilbert polynomial, and pointwise local divisor class groups. A standalone finite exact-arithmetic checker supplements rather than replaces the proof. A closely analogous abstract K_{3,3} curve occurs in other literature and remains a comparison risk. No independent audit has occurred.
limitations: The claim is for the projective toric variety of the 3-by-3 Birkhoff polytope over the complex numbers. No assertion covers higher-order Birkhoff polytopes, resolutions, or all abstract incarnations of a K_{3,3} Stanley--Reisner curve. The preexisting cubic equation and the general toric class-group sequence are not claimed as new.
title: The complete singular scheme and local divisor theory of the three-by-three Birkhoff toric variety
